California's Proposition 99 as an sdid_panel

Source: R/panel.R
prop99_panel.Rd

The example panel from Abadie, Diamond and Hainmueller (2010) and Arkhangelsky et al. (2021): per-capita cigarette sales in 39 US states, 1970-2000, with California treated from 1989. The data ship with synthdid; this wraps them for use with sdid_spec() and fit_spec().

Usage

prop99_panel()

Value

An sdid_panel().

Examples

prop99_panel()
#> 
#> ── sdid_panel 
#> • 39 units (State) x 31 periods (Year, 1970-2000)
#> • outcome PacksPerCapita
#> • treatment treated
#> • columns PacksPerCapita and treated
